lines.beaver_en: Thanks for giving me a ride to the airport.
lines.en: No problem, get in. It's an international flight, right?

lines.beaver_en: Yes, it's a business trip. Is the lane construction finished?
lines.learner: 아직이요. 한 차선만 통행할 수 있대요.
lines.en: Not yet. They say only one lane is open to traffic.
lines.roman: ajigiyo. han chaseonman tonghaenghal su itdaeyo.

lines.beaver: 늦을까 봐 걱정이지만 과속은 안 돼요.
lines.beaver_en: I'm worried we'll be late, but no speeding.
lines.beaver_roman: neujeulkka bwa geokjeongijiman gwasogeun an dwaeyo.
lines.learner: 네, 과속 안 해요. 면허 딴 지 십 년이에요.
lines.en: Right, I won't speed. I've had my license for ten years.
lines.roman: ne, gwasok an haeyo. myeonheo ttan ji simnyeonieyo.

lines.beaver_en: How much is the airport bus fare?
lines.learner: 차비는 만 오천 원이에요. 꽤 비싸요.
lines.en: The fare is 15,000 won. It's pretty expensive.
lines.roman: chabineun man ocheon wonieyo. kkwae bissayo.

lines.beaver_en: Is it cheaper to go by car?
lines.learner: 네, 차로 가면 기름값이 만 원밖에 안 들어요.
lines.en: Yes, by car the gas only costs 10,000 won.
lines.roman: ne, charo gamyeon gireumkkapsi man wonbakke an deureoyo.

lines.beaver: 앞에 터널이 있네요. 공기가 안 좋겠어요.
lines.beaver_en: There's a tunnel ahead. The air will be bad.
lines.beaver_roman: ape teoneori inneyo. gonggiga an jokesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, the sea opens up after the tunnel.
lines.en: Pretty, right? The tunnel lights are pretty at night too.

lines.learner: 아니요. 버스는 밤에 운행을 안 해서 불편해요.
lines.en: No. Buses don't run at night, so it's inconvenient.
lines.roman: aniyo. beoseuneun bame unhaengeul an haeseo bulpyeonhaeyo.

lines.learner: 네, 그래서 이 길은 늘 막혀요.
lines.en: Yes, that's why this road is always jammed.
lines.roman: ne, geuraeseo i gireun neul makyeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: We're at the airport already. Thanks to you, we made it safely.
lines.en: Glad to hear it. Have a good business trip!
